features.description: Use ordinary transition words when moving between related points.
End with a concise restatement of the main point.
Prefer direct sentences whose subjects and actions are easy to identify.
Keep each paragraph focused on one main point.
Add a brief qualification when a statement does not apply universally.

authority: fixed-semantics micro-render input; no candidate-selection authority

rendering_contract.blindness: The renderer receives one anonymous style card and one brief, with no candidate identity, source, hypothesis, other condition, or prior rendering.
rendering_contract.prohibitions: Do not add facts, methods, requirements, permissions, examples, labels, quotations, headings, bullets, or domain claims beyond the brief; do not mention style instructions.
rendering_contract.task: Express every proposition and the required speech act exactly once while realizing the anonymous style features naturally.

semantic_brief.context: Produce a compact technical review decision from the following exact facts.
semantic_brief.output_constraint: One self-contained paragraph of 70 to 110 words with no heading or bullet list.

required_propositions.meaning: A migration renamed three public fields while retaining compatibility aliases.
Twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated; the status of two clients is unknown.
Integration tests cover the twelve migrated clients but not the two clients of unknown status.
Do not remove the aliases until the two remaining client owners confirm migration.

semantic_brief.required_speech_act: A bounded rejection recommendation with an explicit evidence limitation and prerequisite.
